hypothesis: Whole-cluster revalidation, waiting and branch-local retirement can guide primitive continuation while leaving every complete graph degree, scheduler action and base fallback unchanged.
unchanged_semantics: All 229 primitive recipe types, 217 injective formula values, exact global three-hypothesis context and 24 required root rows.
Identity orientation and vertical translation only, exact unit t/m, assigned zero distinct from absent.
No atomic cluster execution, no sampled degree domains and no authority/native/compiler activation.
Current fixed candidate registration/member priority is retained as an ordering control. This phase introduces no RL training or new policy optimization.

immutable_fields: model/context/registry/marking/authority epochs and exact source expansion certificate bindings
ordered receptor ports and premise multiplicity
full decorated primitive keys/identities and literal ordered references
deduplicated exact constituent keys plus cached compatible t-sum/m-union
fixed registration priority and member order
descriptor.sharing_rule: Equal full primitive key/identity is one placement. Same formula or occupancy row does not merge different keys. A member already selected under that exact identity contributes zero additional occupancy.
descriptor.source_relation: Transported source interfaces stay structurally certified for the checked finite relation, not native_accepted. Initial descriptor validation checks all primitive witnesses and exact expanded source/body bindings; node revalidation uses cached point data only under the unchanged frozen authority.

lifecycle.initial_validation: Reject entire stale/internally conflicting/missing-body descriptor. A rejected proposal never removes a primitive candidate.

states.waiting: Every pending constituent remains currently point-legal, but no pending member is incident to the current reference decision point. Keep it for later.
states.ready: Whole cluster remains valid and at least one pending constituent is an eligible incident candidate at the chosen branch point.
states.consumed: All exact constituent identities are selected; keep provenance but supply no new preferred move.
states.retired: At least one pending constituent or aggregate interface is invalid in this branch. Remove all of this cluster's continuation preferences, not only the offending member.

node_validity_checks: Exact immutable model/context/authority/registry versions still match; no mid-run rule update is supported.
Cached internal distinct t sum is within capacity and union m is a function. Ordered repeated ports are not deduplicated.
For members already selected, verify exact decorated identity and support; do not call filled-row candidate legality as if it were a pending move.
For every unselected member, check membership in the complete current graph, including branch-local failed-child exclusions.
Additional t of unselected members plus current occupancy stays within capacity; current assigned marks agree everywhere, including distant and exterior mark-only points.
If any one check fails, retire the entire pending cluster in this branch. Compatible siblings do not remain preferred under the invalid cluster.
lifecycle.selected_other_candidate: A different base key occupying a pending cluster row invalidates the whole cluster even if it produces the same formula.
lifecycle.rule_changes: No activation or mutable inventory change is added. A future such change requires full accepted-prefix/graph/hint replay in a distinct reviewed version.

sequence: Compute the complete global dead/forced/earliest decision from the primitive graph. Hints do not influence counts or point choice.
Dead branches stop; budget unknown is never used as an exclusion certificate.
A forced primitive move executes first regardless of hint; after the graph update resynchronize whole pending hints, then return to global checks.
At a branch, resynchronize every pending hint against the whole current state and current decision point. Keep valid ineligible hints waiting.
Preferred candidates come only from ready hints at that point, in the existing fixed priority/member order. Deduplicate exact repeated preferred keys across shared hints.
Then iterate every remaining complete base candidate in stable order. If no hint is ready or a hint is rejected/retired, the same complete fallback remains.
After each primitive placement or parent-local exclusion, invalidate derived ready caches and resynchronize before the next hinted branch action.
scheduler.no_shortcut: No whole cluster is placed in one transaction or used to declare a move forced.

paired_checkpoint: fixed descriptor registry boundary (first implementation has root-fixed registrations only)
trailed_hint_fields: whole-cluster invalidation reason and branch scope
rollback.operation: Undo graph and hint deltas to the same checkpoint; exact semantic snapshot must match. Recompute an independent canonical hint view as an assertion, not a new policy decision.
rollback.failed_child: Only full exhausted child returns a parent-local base exclusion. Then resynchronize hints in that restored parent; a cluster containing the newly excluded pending key retires there. Unknown/cancelled/resource-limited child creates no exclusion.
rollback.revival: Retirement caused by a child's placement is branch-local: undo that child restores the prior waiting/ready cluster. Root-invalid stale descriptors are not revived.
rollback.metrics: Validation effort/retirement counts are cumulative work, deliberately not undone. No feature/RNG/policy state is introduced in this phase.

cache_and_cost.immutable_compile: Build and verify per-descriptor exact primitive identity/cache once; all earlier source/native admission and transport costs remain bound. No fresh native admission is implied.
cache_and_cost.node_cost: Charge whole-hint scans, point agreement, current-domain membership, waiting/retirement updates, ordering and trail/rollback separately.
cache_and_cost.correctness_before_optimization: First implementation scans every registered pending cluster. Any affected-support cache optimization requires a separately verified complete reverse dependency index.
cache_and_cost.preserve_base: No hint status mutates t/m, recipe availability, frontier or graph exclusions; it changes ordering only.

prospective_controls: A valid hint has no member at the chosen earlier-generation point: it waits while complete fallback proceeds.
Global forced move outside a waiting hint invalidates one of its distant source marks: whole hint retires before the next branch.
One invalid constituent with several still-legal siblings: no sibling keeps preference through that invalid cluster.
Rollback undoes invalidation and restores the exact waiting/ready status and base graph.
Shared exact member in two clusters counts once, but either cluster may retire independently when another constituent conflicts.
A different same-formula recipe at the same row retires the hint; exact selected same key instead consumes that member.
Ordered duplicate-premise ports and assigned zero/absence survive cache, validation and rollback.
Stale epoch/context/body/registry, altered MP/eq template and missing dependency are rejected as whole descriptors.
An exhausted child exclusion retires only parent-scoped affected hints; budget unknown preserves parent graph/hints and generates no exclusion.
Independent direct primitive domains are identical with/without hints at every visited state; eligible preference plus fallback is a complete permutation of the chosen point domain.

gates.first: Freeze new versioned sources, exact inputs, projected counts and 60-second/512-MiB synthetic gate before execution, then independent audit. No actual target run.
gates.second: After review, full-language controlled hint transactions on the same 24-row graph with complete raw domain/count/identity comparisons under a separate at-most-180-second/512-MiB producer and independent gate.
gates.authored_proof_word: Never use the authored24 target word as search seed, training sample or proposal generator. A future authored witness remains an explicitly isolated verification control.
gates.third: Only after both gates pass, separately predeclare fresh discovery trials, policy/proposal provenance, equal inventories, budget, complete replay and whole decoded logical/native certificate strategy.

mathematical_contract: For distinct pending members \(C\setminus S\), validate \(T(p)+\sum_{c\in C\setminus S}t_c(p)\leq 1\) and agreement of the full assigned \(m\)-union with the current state. Missing values remain unconstrained; assigned \(0\) remains a value.
known_limits: This plan is not implemented, executed, independently accepted or activated.
No unrestricted reachable-state or infinite-plane completeness claim.
Native/compiler correspondence and a universal mathematical tile language remain open.
No observed proof-search improvement or new theorem discovery in this planning phase.
source_modification: none; future implementation must be new versioned files
